results.content: § McDonald’s will launch SpongeBob SquarePants x One Piece Happy Meal toys in the United States on Tuesday, September 15. The watery crossover coincides with the LEGO One Piece special releasing on Netflix on September 29, and features 15 toys of SpongeBob characters dressed as One Piece ones, complete with their own little ships. Incidentally, SpongeBob and the One Piece anime both premiered in 1999. In the meantime, Burger King’s Dragon Ball Super menu is available now.
